label: CSV to JSON conversion
description: Convert a CSV file with a header row into a JSON array of objects keyed by header names, saved to a new file. Numeric values are sometimes stored as numbers. Some sessions use an installed converter CLI, and one hit an error on a row with extra cells.
type_rationale: Fully deterministic input-to-output transformation (CSV in, JSON out). A script with options for delimiter and numeric typing covers all variants without model judgment.

retired.reason: demo item; the public repo ships no learned items
